item.title: How Many Fence Posts Do I Need? Fence Post Chart
item.description: Quick fence post chart for 50 to 300 ft fences at 6 ft and 8 ft spacing. Learn the simple formula (posts = sections + 1), how to space posts evenly, and when to add posts for corners and gates.
